patches.name: Accent color
patches.description: Replaces the red of Apple Music (buttons, links, the selected tab, progress) with another color. Blue matches the liquid tab bar.

targets.description: Floating tab bar and mini player redesign

options.title: Color in the dark theme
options.description: Accent color when Apple Music is dark, as #RRGGBB. Apple's is #FA2D48.

options.title: Color in the light theme
options.description: Accent color when Apple Music is light, as #RRGGBB. Apple's is #FA233B.

patches.name: Liquid Glass
patches.description: Liquid Glass on the floating tab bar and the mini player: clear glass with refracted edges, vibrancy and a specular rim, and the liquid tab bar of Backdrop by Kyant, with a drop of glass on the active tab. Refraction requires Android 13, the rest Android 12.

targets.description: Floating tab bar and mini player redesign

options.title: Blur radius
options.description: Blur of the content behind the glass, in dp. Off keeps the glass clear, as Liquid Glass.

options.title: Refraction width
options.description: Width of the bent band along the edges of the glass, in dp. 0 disables the refraction.

options.title: Refraction strength
options.description: How far the content is displaced at the very edge of the glass, in dp.

options.title: Vibrancy
options.description: Saturation of the content behind the glass, in percent. 100 keeps the colors unchanged.

options.title: Tint opacity
options.description: Opacity kept from the translucent material Apple Music draws over the tab bar and the mini player, in percent. Lower values show more of the glass.

options.title: Edge highlight
options.description: Intensity of the light reflected on the rim of the glass, in percent.

options.title: Chromatic aberration
options.description: Splits the colors of the refracted edges, like a prism (Android 13+).

options.title: Search bar
options.description: Also applies the glass to the floating search bar and to the top bar on tablets.

options.title: Tablet sidebar
options.description: Also applies the glass to the sidebar on tablets.

options.title: Liquid tab bar
options.description: Draws the tab bar with LiquidBottomTabs, the liquid tab bar of Backdrop by Kyant: a drop of glass follows the active tab and can be dragged from tab to tab. Its glass has a light blur of its own.

options.title: Tab labels
options.description: Shows the names of the tabs under their icons in the liquid tab bar.

options.title: Hide the New tab
options.description: Removes the New tab from the liquid tab bar.

options.title: Hide the Radio tab
options.description: Removes the Radio tab from the liquid tab bar.

options.title: Start tab
options.description: Tab the app opens on, with the liquid tab bar.

options.title: Haptic feedback
options.description: A light tick when the active tab changes, in the liquid tab bar.

patches.name: Liquid Glass icon
patches.description: Replaces the app icon with the LiquidMusic icon: a drop of glass over the colors. It also has a themed icon for Android 13+.

targets.description: Floating tab bar and mini player redesign
